paragraphs.text:
The camp seems relatively empty of the creatures. Perhaps the 
bulk of them are foraging. You creep to the spot where you last 
saw Sylvia and whisper her name.

Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 394; if the result is odd, go 
to 420.
